## Full-suite results and two anomalies, both explained (neither is a regression from this change)

Ran the complete unit + interfaces suite against the fix: **10208 passed, 38 skipped**.

Two non-green entries, both investigated:

1. `tests/unit/metrics/test_jscpd_dup_heldout.py::test_live_clone` -- `assert 0 >= 1`.
   **PRE-EXISTING and environmental.** Verified by checking out the base commit befc62d2090
   (origin/main, before this change) and running it there: it fails identically. The jscpd
   duplication detector finds 0 clones in this local environment. Nothing in this change touches
   the metrics adapter.

2. `Failed: Test moved the repo HEAD (befc62d209 -> d6fd1101e1)` -- **an artifact of my own
   concurrent `git commit`**, not a test defect. The suite was running in the background when
   the fix commit landed, and the session guard correctly flagged the HEAD move. It attributed to
   a DIFFERENT test in each of the two runs (`test_claim_transition_parent_cascade` in one,
   `test_push_rejection_surfacing` in the other), which is the signature of a global HEAD-move
   guard rather than a per-test failure.

Gerrit change 1470 has **LLM-Review +1**; awaiting **Verified** (CI runs the authoritative full
suite). Per AGENTS.md this ticket stays open until that change is Verified +1 and merged.
